name: Crumb Brothers Bakery (Logan) Long-Fermented Sourdough Loaf, Turkey Sandwich & Soup
brandOrRestaurant: Crumb Brothers Artisan Bread & Cafe (Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Crumb Brothers is famous across Utah for true slow-fermented artisan country white sourdough, where wild yeast fermentation pre-digests gluten and fructans for effortless Crohn's digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a sliced Country White Sourdough loaf or butter croissants for home/cabin toast, or order a hot Turkey & Cheese sandwich on white sourdough (skip seeded multi-grain loaves).
watchOuts: Choose unseeded Country White Sourdough or French Baguette over seeded whole-grain loaves
